about: Which tools each role may use, and which repositories its definition is rendered into. The role files say what a role must not do; that is intent. This file is the part a tool layer can enforce. Neither is complete alone. Changed only by pull request. The main manager renders into no repository: it is the top-level session, instructed by MANAGER.md.

tools.shell: run commands, subject to the deny list in agent-settings.json
tools.browser: drive a real browser against a deployed host
tools.record: run bin/record.py, and add new files under a ticket's evidence folder

repos.product: the portal's codebase, which has its own AGENTS.md
